executive_summary: 2026-08-10 正式 RadarReportV2 已完成：live_multi、status=partial、52 件事件（39 Major／13 Potential），其中 37 件含台灣直接證據。事件集中在宏觀、AI 與科技；正式選入零售事件為 0，不能把零售低覆蓋解讀成市場沒有變化。
AI 主線仍由模型外溢到伺服器、記憶體、資料中心與企業損益。Rohm、Innodisk、WT Micro 的正式事件顯示需求仍能拉動營運結果，但 VSO 與 Apple 相關事件同時提示記憶體供給瓶頸；因此『基建需求強』不等於所有 AI 投資都有正 ROI。
ROI 是今天最重要的補搜。Reuters Breakingviews 引述 KPMG：2,145 位主管中僅 7% 能證明 AI 投資回報，近半曾因成本超過效益而質疑、延後或縮減 agent；Santander 官方卻揭露 H1 AI 已產生 8,400 萬歐元 business value。較合理的判讀是 AI ROI 正快速分化。
零售正式 lane 缺席，但 Reuters 顯示 Walmart、Ulta、Wayfair 正為 ChatGPT/Gemini referral 調整網站與商品資料，Ulta 並把 cart 與會員整合進 Gemini；台灣經濟部 Q2 網路零售年增 12.1%，官方點名社群導購、會員權益與商品多樣性為驅動。
Crypto 正式報告已有 Hyperliquid RWA/perp 與 Bitcoin 安全事件，但 ETF flows、regulation_policy 缺資料。補搜顯示美國現貨 Bitcoin ETF 8/7 合計淨流入 1.017 億美元；台灣《虛擬資產服務法》已於 7/22 公布並建立 VASP 許可制。

三個 structural 與六個 linked indicators 完全交由同一份正式報告的 deterministic baseline hydrate，不由 ChatGPT 改分。剩餘 runtime 缺口是 FreshRSS 憑證、external discovery/collection 未接線與 WACA 405；另發現 crypto 明顯誤分類與 matrix orphan ids，列入回測。

limitations: RadarReportV2 status=partial：web/API/social adapters 未由 RSS composition 執行，external discovery/collection 未接線，FreshRSS 缺必要憑證；補搜不能把 runtime gap 改寫成完成。
今日 selected retail_consumer_fashion=0，但 retail matrix 仍有一格 observed；因此不能把零售低事件數解讀成市場安靜。
Retail 8 個 gap 已找到 online/social、loyalty、AI referral、assortment、cost/markdown、Taiwan retail、segmentation 補證，但多數非 same-day 台灣量測，formal matrix 不改。
Crypto 兩個 gap etf_flows、regulation_policy 均有補證；Farside 是 specialist tracker，台灣法規已公布但子法與發照進度仍待追。
ai_bubble_overinvestment.utilization_roi deterministic component 仍資料不足；本次同時加入低 ROI 調查與 Santander 正 ROI 案例，只判讀為分化，不改 structural score。
今日 deterministic AI fallback 因 provider/model、mode、fallback 與 source mismatch 未過 production AI gate，先以 report-only 部署；本檔重新綁定今日 report/run/context hash。
補搜已檢查 Anthropic、BLS、IMF、IEA、DeFiLlama、TWSE、FSC/總統府、CBC、MOL、MOEA、立院、行政院、Commercial Times、CryptoCity、WACA。部分無 8/7–8/10 新量測；Commercial Times robots 阻擋；未用舊材料冒充 same-day。
evt_45c0ec148d29 的 BNT 疫苗詐欺被誤分 crypto Potential，應加 crypto entity/type minimum-evidence guard。
retail matrix evt_08f1106ed402 與 crypto matrix 多個 observed ids 無法在今日 selected entities 解析；建議新增 matrix referential-integrity completion gate。
WACA /pos adapter 回報 405，但官方 support 頁可公開讀取，較像 method/endpoint 問題；建議 405 fallback 至 GET/canonical support route。Immutable arrays 以空陣列提交，僅由正式 importer 從同一 RadarReportV2 hydrate。

evidence.headline: Commentary: From free flow to tight control — how tech talent became a national security asset
evidence.summary: Tech talent has moved from being simply a hiring priority to a matter of national security. As major economies increasingly tie talent to competitiveness and national security, control over its cross-border movement is tightening. That shift is visible today: Taiwan's Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau is probing 17 companies accused of illegally recruiting tech talent in Taiwan, China is preparing to tighten exit controls on key technical workers, and the US continues expanding semiconductor and AI export controls and research security reviews.（命中：hiring）

Whitehall wants to triple their number in the UK. Yet in Slough, I saw the impact they’re having on communities

Amid headlines about the UK’s drought, Europe’s wildfires and impossible global temperatures, it was 28C when I arrived in Slough last Monday. I was there to look around Slough Trading Estate, a place that might once have conjured up images of the TV comedy The Office, many of whose laughs came at the expense of this overgrown patch of suburbia, 20-odd miles west of London.

But these days, this area of town – an incongruous mixture of old-school businesses such as Mr Clutch and Angling Direct, and vast, metal-clad leviathans that look like something pulled from JG Ballard – has become a byword for the constant expansion of datacentres, those hulking symbols of the vast computing power that big tech now requires, not least because of the ever-more complex workings of artificial intelligence.

Architect’s vision for redevelopment of heart of EU quarter unrealised amid political wrangling and rising costs

The redevelopment plan for Schuman Square at the heart of the EU quarter in Brussels was very ambitious. From a traffic-clogged, nondescript roundabout, it would become “an urban agora”, a greener, calmer meeting place, nothing less, said a former head of the Brussels government, than “a symbol that beats as the heart … of the European project”.

It did not turn out that way. The result, say critics, is Europe’s largest frying pan, a concrete expanse with little greenery or shade. While the number of cars has reduced and the space is remodelled with smart grey paving, the centrepiece – a steel canopy with a green roof – was never built.
